children: Iron ore prices are higher in early Asian trading. Overall iron-ore shipments are continuing a seasonal upward trend, remaining at relatively high levels, according to Nanhua Futures analysts in a commentary. Ahead of the upcoming long holiday in China, steel mills are actively building up inventory, they note. The most-traded iron-ore contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange is 0.1% higher at CNY722.0 a ton. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
